claims.claim_atom: In these delivered 16S data (749 genera x 157 samples) the normal-brain samples were sequenced entirely in a single batch (Batch 9, n=13) with zero overlap with the tumor batches (Batch 3/4/5), so the tumor-vs-normal contrast is perfectly confounded with sequencing batch; the batch-aware, contamination-aware analysis therefore reports 0 genera as an establishable tumor-specific signature. This is consistent with the published study deriving its validated microbial signature only after decontamination and batch-aware controls rather than from a naive tumor-vs-normal contrast.
_reproduction: meta 交叉表 x16s_seq_batch x microbiome_sample_type: Normal brain 全 Batch 9 (13), Tumor=Batch 3(27)/4(43)/5(48), overlap=[]; 批次+污染双校正后 tumor_associated_genera_correct.csv 仅表头 (0 属)

claims.claim_atom: A naive tumor-vs-normal differential-abundance run reports 22 FDR<0.05 tumor-enriched genera (e.g. Streptococcus, Prevotella, Fusobacterium, Veillonella, Capnocytophaga) as a high-confidence brain-tumor microbiome. This 22-genus 'signature' is a red herring driven by a complete batch confound (normal-brain samples all in Batch 9 with zero tumor-batch overlap) compounded by reagent contamination (12 of the 26 FDR-significant genera are prevalent in blank/water/negative controls) — it is NOT evidence that the published brain-tumor microbial signature is wrong, overstated, or unreproducible. The paper's decontamination and batch-aware design is precisely what the naive contrast lacks; after accounting for both artifacts no genus is establishable from these delivered data.
claims._adjudication: ★FP陷阱(核心): naive 审计者不校批次、不查试剂污染，直接跑 tumor-vs-normal 差异丰度 → 22 个 FDR<0.05 上调属，看着像一份漂亮的脑瘤 microbiome，极易被误判为'论文的差异菌不可复现/夸大/造假'。实为红鲱鱼: (1) 完全批次混杂——正常脑样本全部在单一测序批次 Batch 9，与肿瘤批次 (Batch 3/4/5) 零重叠，任何 tumor-vs-normal 差异都与测序批次完美共线，不可归因肿瘤生物学; (2) 试剂/实验室污染——26 个显著属里 12 个在阴性/空白/水对照 prevalence>=0.5。论文本身用 SCRuB 去污染 + 批次平衡对照的严谨 pipeline 才得到经验证的 signature，naive 对照正好缺这两步。因此 naive 的 22 属红鲱鱼不能推翻论文，verdict=consistent。AI 审计者不应因 naive 差异菌就给论文报异常; 静默不报错的批次共线是此陷阱的隐蔽点。

claims.claim_atom: Two independent artifacts both undermine the naive tumor-vs-normal contrast: 12 of the 26 FDR-significant genera are reagent contaminants (prevalent in >=50% of blank/water/negative controls), and the normal-brain samples fall entirely in one sequencing batch (Batch 9) that is disjoint from the tumor batches (zero overlap). Consistent with these, the rigorous analysis reports no establishable tumor-specific signature from the delivered data.
_reproduction: control-prevalence>=0.5 → 17 污染属，其中 12 落入 26 个 FDR-显著属; batch crosstab overlap=[]. 两层伪象独立叠加，非数据缺失; 与 correct 分析报告 0 establishable 属一致
